pattern.description: Tail of the end-card lockup: the completed workday / Adaptive Planning lockup keeps a slow, decelerating scale drift (about 1 percent) as it settles, with the free-trial URL beneath.
pattern.why_premium: A barely perceptible continued drift keeps the end card alive instead of freezing, so the logo feels like it is landing rather than stopping dead.

build_hint.gsap: Continue the lockup timeline with gsap.to('.lockup', {scale: 1.01, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power3.out'}) on the whole group (wordmark, arc and name together).
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 24], [1, 1.01], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the lockup container; alternatively spring({damping: 200}) for an overshoot-free settle.

notes: Motion is very subtle (scale 1.0098, decaying energy); it may be the settling tail of e058 rather than a separate designed move. The URL line visible at the end frame has no candidate box and its entrance is not visible in the cropped filmstrip, so it is not listed.
